customers_say: Customers find the door lock to be of excellent quality, with great looks, smooth installation process, and many features including fingerprint and passcode entry options. Moreover, they appreciate its convenience and good customer service support. However, the functionality receives mixed reviews, with some reporting issues with the front lock not working. Additionally, connectivity is a concern, with several customers experiencing no wifi connectivity.

reviews.title: Touchpad constantly lit, fingerprint scanner completely dead.
reviews.body: The product is beautiful when it comes to aesthetic/design. But the service that Qubo provides is really very poor. The finger print scanner stopped working completely, it is dead and the keypad is constantly lit draining the battery constantly, the guy who came through support after 5 days said the lock will be replaced only to disappoint later saying it is not in warranty any more. reviews.author: Kanraj Jain
reviews.title: Good Features, but Fingerprint Sensitivity Needs Improvement
reviews.body: The Qubo Smart Lock offers great functionality overall—keyless entry works seamlessly, and the mobile app integration is smooth. Installation was fairly straightforward, and the build quality feels solid and premium. However, one major drawback I faced was while trying to register fingerprints. It consistently failed to recognize or register my wife’s fingerprint, no matter how many times we tried. This could be a serious limitation for elderly users or those with faint fingerprint patterns. Pros: • Sleek design and good build quality • Easy to install • Convenient keyless entry with multiple
